figures.caption: Table 1: Structured relational reasoning on GQA. Shaded rows denote MIRROR-enhanced models. Bold highlights notable gains (∆ ≥ 1.0).

Fig. 4: Cross-attention analysis from two perspectives. (a,b) Layer-wise: intermediate layers achieve balanced information richness and peak concentration. (c) Headwise (Layer 16): low-entropy heads yield clearer cross-modal alignment.

Fig. 2: Overview of the MLLM architecture. An image is encoded into visual tokens via a vision encoder and adapter, then concatenated with text tokens and fed into the language model. Av denotes visual self-attention from the vision encoder, C the cross-modal attention from text to visual tokens, and At the causal text self-attention within the language model.
